tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// dzayenabimalaṃbyākaraṇobadz+radharānan+dabhadapādas+yaprawatsanaṃdwipustakoshrīhebadz+ras+yasādhanodāraṃbhāṣanor+pādānu/ kramamarmas+yan+turasmināmabidzaharatisma//

༄༅// rgyal bas dri med lung gis bsngags pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab glegs bam gnyis pa las dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ shrīhebadz+ras+yasādhanodāraṃbhāṣaṇot+pādānukramamarmas+yen+durasminām/ namobhaṭ+ṭārakas+saṅgurūṇām+pādāyashirasābhak+tinā/ ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro la spyir ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi rnam grangs stong phrag bzhi dang go drug mchis pa'i nang gsel gzhung gis dngos su ma zin pa nyis brgya dgu pa nas rnyed pa'i prastā ras bcings pa'o// yas+yapradz+nyāsahasradhareṇāṃshwāt+mas+sarbādz+nyānaṃmatestamayan+takṛtwamra/ saṃmat+yut+pādakār+yabhawatwālokomañdzur+ghoṣāt+masaṅgurunārāk+ṣit+yaḥ gang gi mkhyen rab 'od stong bdag po yis// bdag blo'i mi shes mun pa kun bsal nas// yang dag blo gros snang ba bskyed mdzad pa// 'jam dbyangs bla mas bdag cag skyong gyur cig /gang sku 'jigs rung khro bar gnas kyang ma lus 'gro ba'i khro ba 'joms// de gsung dregs pa'i nga ro sgrogs kyang stobs ldan bdud bzhi'i dregs pa 'dul// khyod thugs spros pas kun nas dben yang srid gsum spros med snying rjes skyob// khro chags rnam lnga'i rol par bzhugs kyang dug lnga 'joms la bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rim gnyis cha shas rdzogs// spangs rtogs yon tan du ma'i 'od dkar 'phro// phrin las ri dwags mtshan mas nyer mdzes pa// dpal ldan mi thub zla ba'i zhabs la 'dud// bdud rtsi 'tsho byed lha dbang min kyang rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i zas la rol// 'dod dgu'i dpal ster nor bu min kyang gdul bya'i 'dod dgu'i re ba skang*// chu klung kun 'dus rgya mtsho min kyang legs bshad chu gter sa skya pa// snang ba'i dpal bskyed rta bdun min kyang thub bstan snang byed mkhas rnams rgyal// gang gis thos na rna ba'i dpal bskyed cing*// bsams na legs bshad snang ba 'phel 'gyur la// bsgoms na rdo rje 'dzin pa thob nges pa'i// sgrub thabs mchog 'di'i rnam bshad bdag gis bri// 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gang dag gting mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por brnag par dka' ba'i las drag pos shin tu nyam thag par byas pa'i 'gro ba 'di rnams tshe 'di nyid la/

mya ngan las 'das pa'i skam sar bde bar phyin par byed pa'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa tshol bar byed pa'i gang zag de dag gis don du gnyer bar bya ba'i lam ni/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi sgor zhugs nas/ mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sngon du 'gro ba can gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa yang dag par bzung nas/ rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa la brtson 'grus drag pos rnal 'byor du byed pa'i lam 'di kho na yin la/ lam gyi rim pa de yang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos gdul bya so so'i khams dang mthun par rgyud sde rin po che rnams las tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bka' stsal pa las 'dir kun rdzob tu shes rab kyi rgyud gtso che zhing*/ don dam par na thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di bshad par bya ba la spyi don gsum ste/ sgrub thabs 'di lam srol gang gi phyogs su gtogs ngos bzung ba/ ngos zin pa'i sgrub thabs kyi mtshan gyi don/ mtshan de dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs dngos so// dang po la gsum/ spyir 'phags yul gyi srol ji tsam yod tshul/ de las bod kyi bla ma rnams gang gi rjes su 'brangs dpyad pa/ bye brag tu snying por gyur pa'i lam srol ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i shing rta'i srol chen po drug yod de/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rjes thog mar slob ma smin byed kyi lam ston pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas gling mar grags pa dang*/ grol lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i gdams ngag de rnams kyi lam gyi yan lag tu tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstod pa nyi shu pa/ de thams cad kyi rgyab brten du rtsa rgyud kyi dka' 'grel pad+ma can rnams mdzad la/

de'i slob ma slob dpon in+d+ra bhū tis/ sam+bu ṭa'i 'grel pa yang dag pa'i lta ba'i dran pa'i snang ba zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel zhal nas brgyud pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ 'di dang gur brtag pa dang po'i bshad sbyar slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa gnyis 'gyur khyad tsam ma gtogs khyad par cung zad kyang mi snang ngo*// srol 'di ni phyis kyi paṇ+ḍi ta snyan grags bzang po dang*/ gnyis med rdo rje la sogs pa rgya gar ba mang pos tshad mar byed pas rtsod pa dang bral ba'i lam du snang ngo*// yang grub chen mi thub zla bas smin byed kyi cho ga dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung*/ grol lam bskyed rim la rigs lnga char gyi sgrub thabs ston pa/ gur rigs bsdus kyi mngon rtogs/ bye brag tu mi bskyod pa'i rigs can rnams la kye rdo rje yab kyi sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ yum bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs/ sgrub thabs gsum char la 'jug pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rnams dang*/ rdzogs rim la gtum mo'i 'grel chung mdzad ces rje btsun chen pos bshad la/ da lta yod pa'i gtum mo'i 'grel chung gi mjug na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rat+na shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad zer ba snang ba la/ mchan rnying par don slob dpon mi thub zla bas mdzad pa yin pa la/ bla ma bsod snyoms pa'i mtshan bcug pa'o// zhes bris pa ni mi 'thad de/ bsod snyoms pa'i mtshan ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ dza ya shrī shān+ti zhes bshad pa dang 'gal zhing*/ ku mu tir bshad pa'i gtum mo dang 'di gnyis mi mthun la/ 'di nas bshad pa'i gtum mo dang*/ slob dpon nag po pa'i o la pa ti gnyis don gcig tu snang bas/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa min mod/ 'on kyang o la pa ti kye rdor dang bde mchog thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung yin pas/ de'i don bsdus nas rje btsun ga ya dha ras mdzad pa yin la/ rat+na shrī dz+nyā na yang ga ya dha ra'i mtshan yin no// de dag gi rgyab brten du dka' 'grel ku mu ti rnams mdzad do// lugs 'di ni rje btsun bir+wa pa'i bzhed pa yin pas/

brtson 'grus can tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya ba la mi dgos kha med kyi lam khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// yang rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa lta bu slob dpon shān+ti pas bskyed rim la yab kyi sgrub thabs 'khrul pa spong ba/ yum gyi sgrub thabs rgyas par bstan pa/ rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba la yang dag par sbyor ba rnams dang*/ de rnams kyi rgyab brten du dka' 'grel mu tig phreng ba rnams mdzad la/ slob dpon de'i dngos slob nyin mor byed pa'i 'byung gnas zla bas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga he ru ka 'byung ba/ sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi 'grel pa ye shes sgron mer mngon par brjod pa rnams mdzad la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 'grel pa zhig kyang yod par bshad mod/ bod du ma 'gyur pa 'dra'o// shān+ti pa'i dngos slob bram ze tha ga nas/ rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 'grel pa mdzad la/ gzhung 'di rnams la brten nas thog mar smin byed kyi cho gas snod rung du byas/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyis bskyed rim brtan par byas nas rdzogs rim gtum mo cung zad dang*/ las rgya gtso bor bsgoms pas/ sems tsam gyi lta ba rnam par dag pa rtogs par byed pa'i thabs yin zhing*/ slob dpon 'di 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ gzhan ni gtum mo dang las rgya bsgoms pas dbu ma'i lta ba kho na rgyud la skye ba mi srid do/ slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros dang*/ bdag nyid chen po slob dpon a bha yā ka ra yang slob dpon 'di'i rjes su 'brangs la/ dang pos gur gyi dka' 'grel de kho na nyid rgyas pa dang*/ phyi mas sam+bu ṭa'i 'grel pa man ngag gi snye ma mdzad do// yang slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje'i dngos slob nag po shān+ti bha dras smin byed dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhung 'grel/ bskyed rim la lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/

yab rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ yum rkyang gi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung zhig kyang yod par rje btsun chen pos bshad kyang da lta de'i dpe mi snang ngo*// lam gyi yan lag la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di dang sngar gyi slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gnyis don gcig par snang*/ ro sreg gi cho ga rab gnas kyi cho ga mchod rten gyi cho ga gshin gyi cho ga rnams dang*/ de dag gi rgyab brten du dka' 'grel rnal 'byor rin po che sbyor ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba rnams mdzad do// slob dpon 'dis bod du byon nas/ mang yul lha khang ka ru zhes bya bar 'gos lots+tsha ba/ mtshur lots+tsha ba/ nag tsho gsum gyis zhus nas/ gzhung chung 'di rnams mdzad nas/ dka' 'grel sbyor phreng ni dang po rgya gar du brtsams nas bla ma la phul bas legs kyi mtshan thogs shig gsungs nas mtshan btags te/ bdag gis byas pas mi 'dul bas bla ma'i mtshan 'jug par zhu byas nas/ dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad par btags so// zhes zer ro// lugs 'di lta ba sems tsam du mi 'grel kyang bskyed rim dang rgyud kyi bshad pa gnyis char slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa las bris bshus byas pa lta bur snang bas shān+ti pa'i rjes 'brang du go bar bya'o// yang rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa kha che snyan grags bzang pos mdzad pa/ nā ro bde mchog pa'i nā ro pa dang 'di mi gcig la/ 'on kyang bde mchog nā ro ta pa yang kha che rin chen rdo rje dang grogs mched yin par bshad pas kha che ba yin pa tsam dgag tu med do// 'grel chen du grags pa der/ smin byed kyi cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa bla med gzhan dang cha mthun par bshad cing*/ grol lam bskyed rim grub chen mtsho skyes dang cha mthun pa dang*/ rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ mthun par gsungs la/ de dag gi dbang bka' bshad bka' sbyor drug gi man ngag nā ro pa'i sgrom gter grags pa'i khrid bka' rnams/

bla ma dpyal chos kyi bzang po lots+tsha ba nas brgyud de deng sang yang ma chad par yod de/ lugs 'di ni nges don gyi bshad pa shas che zhing khyad par du 'phags pa zhig snang ngo*// yang mnga' bdag mai tri pa zhes kyang bya/ gnyis med rdo rje'am/ a wa dhū tī zhes bya ba'i grub chen des smin byed dbang gi rab byed/ bskyed rim la yab kyi sgrub thabs rnam par dag pa'i gter/ yum gyi sgrub thabs bdag med ma gsal ba/ rdzogs rim la lta ba ngan sel rtsa 'grel gnyis/ rin chen phreng ba/ dbang gi dgos pa/ rnam pa lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i phyag rgya/ sgyu ma nges bstan/ rmi lam nges bstan/ rab tu mi gnas pa/ theg chen nyi shu pa/ de kho na nyid nyi shu pa/ brtse ba lnga pa/ dga' gcugs lnga pa/ mi phyed pa lnga pa/ dbu ma drug pa/ lhan skyes drug pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba/ bde chen gsal ba/ gnas pa bsdus pa shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ dbang bskur rnam nges kyi dka' 'grel rnams mdzad la/ gzhung 'di rnams la a ma na si nyi shu rtsa bzhi zer nas gsang 'dus dang thun mong gi gdams ngag lta bur snang yang*/ rje btsun chen pos kye rdo rje'i gdams ngag du mdzad do// de ltar lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i shing rta'i srol chen po da lta bod na bzhugs pa ni drug po de tsam du zad la/ gzhan rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa bdun tsam dang*/ byang chub snying po la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung drug tsam snang mod/ lam yongs su rdzogs pa mi snang bas ma bris so// gnyis pa ni/ gangs can gyi khrod 'dir sngar byon pa'i mkhas pa/ dpyal lots+tsha ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ se ba dang*/ gtum blo gros grags ston dang*/ ram 'byung gnas rdo rje sdings pa rnams ni rgya gar ba'i man ngag brgyud pa la brten par snang zhing*/ lam yongs su rdzogs pa'ang med la/ bla ma chos kyi rdo rje

rngog pa rnams ni dpal nā ro pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa rje mar pa nas brgyud nas smin lam yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed rim yan lag drug pa/ rdzogs rim bsre 'pho'i man ngag de'i rgyab brten du gur brtag gnyis kyi bshad bka' dang bcas pa ste/ lugs 'di yang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin no// de rnams kyi nang nas/ bod yul bstan pa'i sgron me rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs 'di 'phags yul gyi gzhung gang gi rjes su 'brang snyam na/ rje btsun chen pos/ snying po don gyi kye rdor ni// bir+wa'i rjes 'brang ḍom+bhi'i skor// yan lag med rjes pad+ma'i skor// dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor// gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu// lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro// zhes gsungs pas sngar gyi mtsho skyes kyi chos skor dang*/ nag po pa'i skor dang*/ rje btsun bir+wa pa'i rjes 'brang la/ slob dpon nag po pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag lugs dang*/ mi thub zla ba'i chos skor 'grel pa lugs su grags pa ste/ 'di gnyis ngo bo gcig yin pas lugs gsum mam/ bla ma dag gi gsung sgros la 'di gnyis po so sor phye nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol bzhi zhes gsungs la/ lugs de rnams gtso bor 'dzin zhing rgya gzhung gzhan rnams bar skabs su ji ltar 'tsham par gsung bar bshad do// gsum pa ni/ 'dir rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong bir+wa pa nyid kyi rnam par phye ba'i shing rta'i srol chen po gang yin pa de bshad par bya ba la bzhi/ mdzad pa po slob dpon ngos bzung ba/ de la slob ma ji ltar byung tshul/ de rnams kyis lam ji ltar bkral ba/ de dag gi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ kha ku mā ra ma ti cig lam 'di'i mdzad pa po bir+wa pa ni sems tsam pa yin te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'grel par/ dbyig gnyen dang*/ dpal ldan chos skyong la sogs pa rnams sems tsam gyi paṇ+ḍi tar bshad cing*/

rgyud gsum gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i bir+wa pa'i bshad pa rnams su/ gzhi'i skabs su kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa khas blangs pa dang*/ lam gyi skabs su snang ba sems su 'dod pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i skabs su gnas gyur khas len pa'i phyir/ sems tsam las ma 'das zhes 'dod do// de la lan 'debs pa'i mkhas pa kha cig dbu ma pa rnams kyi phyogs sngar byed pa'i chos skyong ni/ bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel par/ da lta'i snyan ngag mkhan btsun pa chos skyong zhes bshad pas/ dpal ldan chos skyong min no zhes 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/

pho rus tsam yin mod/ dbu ma bden gnyis las/ bden pa gnyis po rnam phye yang*// shing rta che dag rmongs nyid na// gzhan rnams smos kyang ci dgos te// zhes dang*/ de'i dka' 'grel slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad par gang dag slob dpon chos skyong la sogs pa'i lta ba'i rjes su 'brang bas zhugs pa de dag ni shin tu rmongs pa kho na yin pa'i phyir gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ zhes gsungs shing*/ don de nyid thugs la bzhag nas/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ 'jig rten kun gyi rgyan gyur te// shing rta chen po zhes su grags// dpal ldan chos skyong mtshan ldan pa// 'jigs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs shing*/ lam 'bras kyi zin bris kha bar rdo rje rgyal mtshan cig tu/ sems tsam gyi paṇ+ḍi tar bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// des na slob dpon 'dis dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab kyi 'grel pa dkar po rnam par 'char ba zhes bya ba mdzad ces mkhas pa dag gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de/ rtsa she'i 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las/ slob dpon de ba shar mas rang gi dbu ma'i 'grel pa dkar po 'char ba zhes bya ba zhes bshad kyi/ slob dpon chos skyong gis mdzad par ma bshad do// des na 'grel pa de nyid las/ gnas brtan chos skyong gis kyang slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i/ dbu ma'i tshig le'ur byed pa bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa byas pa las zhes bshad pa ltar bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa brtsams pa'i dus su sems tsam gyi paṇ+ḍi ta yin kyang*/ 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i bar la/ bde mchog gi sgrub pa mdzad pas/ bdag med mas byin gyis brlabs te/ sa dang po thob nas dbu ma par gyur pa yin te/ gtam rgyud las/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad kyang grub rtags ma byung bas thugs skyo ste/ da phan chad chos 'chad pa dang*/ brtsams pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba las yi dam gyi lha'i sgrub pa mi byed do// zhes dam bcas nas/

dpyid zla ra ba sa ga'i nyi shu gnyis kyi nub mo phreng ba chab khung du bskyur nas ci bder gnas so// de'i nub mo rmi lam du bdag med ma tha mal pa'i bud med sngon mo'i gzugs su byon te/ rigs kyi bu tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i spyod pa de lta bu byed pa ma legs pas/ phreng ba long la dri zhim po'i chus khrus la bshags sdom legs par gyis la/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du gyis shig khyod kyis las bsags pa'i lha nga yin pas ngas byin gyis brlabs kyi khyod kyis dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur ro gsungs nas mi snang bar gshegs so// de nas mnal sad de 'gyod pa skyes nas sa ga'i nyi shu gsum gyi nyin mor phreng ba blangs te lung bstan pa bzhin byas pa dang*/ de'i nub mor sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi snang ba bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par byon te/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur bas/ sa dang po mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes skyes/ de lta bu zhag bdun gyis mthar nyi shu dgur song ba'i nub mor sa drug gi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes par bshad pas/ bdag med mas dbang bskur phyin chad chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bu thugs su chud nas dbu ma par gyur pa yin te/ sems tsam pa yin na des bden pa mthong ba'i skabs med par thal rang gnyis kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams bzhed de/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ don dam pa'i bden pa ma rtogs par nyon mongs pa spong mi nus la de ma spangs par thar pa thob pa med pa'i phyir/ rnam rig pa man chad kyi lta ba la brten nas thar pa yang mi thob na/ thams cad mkhyen pa lta ci smos zhes bzhed la/ slob dpon legs ldan byed la sogs pa ni/ nyan thos sde gnyis kyi lta bas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs nus pas thar pa thob la/ shes sgrib spong mi nus pas thams cad mkhyen pa mi thob cing*/ rnam rig pa'i lta ba la brten nas thar pa yang mi thob ste/

gang zag gi bdag 'dzin tsam spangs pa'i thar pa don du mi gnyer ba'i phyir dang*/ rang gi lta ba de nyid chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa chen po yin pas/ bdag 'dzin gnyis ka ma spangs pa'i thar pa thob pa mi srid par bzhed do// mdor na sems tsam gyi lta bas bden pa mthong bar yang mi nus na/ sa drug pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la bskyed mi nus pa ni lta smos kyang ci dgos pa la/ grub chen 'dis sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i phyir ro// gal ri bo dge ldan pa chen po/ te gtam rgyud tsam khungs su byed pa dka' na shes byed tshad ma gzhan ci yod snyam na rang gi rtogs brjod kyi do ha las/ nga bdag rtsad nas thon pas bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal// dngos 'dzin rang sar zhig pas 'khor 'das kun las grol// zhes gsungs pas mthong lam ma skyes bar la ngar 'dzin rtsad nas mi thon pa la/ grub chen 'dis ngar 'dzin rtsad nas thon par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir ro// sngags kyi gzhung rnams ni sa drug pa brnyes phyin chad mdzad pa yin pas na dbu ma'i lam kho na yin gyi/ rnam par rig pa'i tshul du nam yang bshad pa med do// 'o na sngar gyi skyon gsum po ji ltar spong snyam na/ gzhi'i skabs su kun gzhi'i rnam shes khas len pa'i phyir sems tsam pa yin zhes pa'ang don ma go ba ste/ dbu ma pa rnams kyi dgag bya'i kun gzhi ni/ rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad kyi ya gyal du gyur pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam shes bden grub tu 'dod pa de yin la/ khas blangs pa'i phyir zer na/ grub chen 'dis bshad pa'i kun gzhi ni/ sems myong rig bye brag tu ma bye ba'i ris sam phyogs su ma chad pa/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhir btags par 'dod la/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ thabs kyis zin pa dang*/ ma zin pa'i bye brag gis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis kar gyi gzhi byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa yin la/

'di tsam zhig khas blangs pas rnam rig par 'gyur na/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ dper na khab len mthong ba na// lcags ni myur du yongs su 'gul// 'di la sems pa yod min na'ang*// sems dang bcas pa bzhin du snang*// de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes// sems med sems dang bcas pa bzhin// 'gro dang 'ong ba rnam g.yo zhing*// rtag tu srid pa gsum po len// dper na rgya mtsho'i mtha' ma las// nges par rlabs ni rnam par g.yo// de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes// lus la brten te g.yo bar byed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir na/ klu sgrub kyang rnam rig smra bar thal ba'i skyon yod do// sbyang gzhi'i skabs su kun gzhi dbu ma pa rnams kyang zhal gyis bzhes te/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis gsang 'dus kyi skabs su 'jam dbyangs kyi sbyang gzhir kun gzhi bshad pa'i phyir ro// rgol ba gnyis pa lam gyi skabs su snang ba sems su 'dod pa'i phyir sems tsam pa yin zhes pa'ang ma brtags pa ste/ sems tsam pa ni phyi rol gyi don bden par med kyi/ snang ba thams cad ni sems su bden par 'dod la/ rtags ma grub/ 'dir ni sems nyid bag chags kyi dbang gis phyi rol gyi dngos po sna tshogs su snang ba yin kyang*/ de'i ngo bo stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de las byung zhing snang ba thams cad kyang stong pa nyid yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ phyi yi thams cad skad cig ma// dga' mo sems kyi cho 'phrul yin// de lta sems las gzhan pa min// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu'o// zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ 'gro dang mi 'gro gang zhig ni// de ni thams cad sems yin no// de yi gzugs drug sems ma yin// sems ni stong pa'i rang bzhin no// ngo bo nyid bral stong pa ste// de bas 'gro ba sems su grub// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na sems tsam pas phyi rol gyi don mi bden pa'i sems bden par 'dod pa dang*/

'dir sgyu ma tsam gyi phyi rol gyi don ni 'dod la sems nyid ni spros pa dang bral bar 'dod pa 'di gnyis dus thams cad du ga la mtshungs/ des na grub chen 'di'i gdams ngag tu/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa la/ rmi lam sogs rtsa ba'i dpe bzhi dang*/ mig yor sogs yan lag gi dpe bzhi ste brgyad gsungs nas/ dpe 'di rnams dang snang ba 'di rnams la khyad par med de/ nyams su ni dpe 'di rnams kyang myong la/ bden par ni snang ba 'di dag kyang ma grub pa'o// zhes snang ba rnams bden med du bshad pa'i phyir ro// don 'di nyid dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'ang bzhed de/ 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba'i le'u bco lnga par/ chos thams cad rmi lam mthong ba'i dus su sems las phyi rol na mi gnas te/ mig yor tsam du snang ba gang yin pa de thams cad ni rang gi sems te/ rang gi sems nyid las gzhan na ci yang med do// sems de gang na gnas zhe na/ nam mkha' rdo rje'i gnas sems 'di// zhes bya ba ste/ nam mkha' rdo rje ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la chos thams cad rten 'brel tsam las dpyad par byar med pa yin pa la/ khyod kyis rten 'brel brjod bral du bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ dbu ma'i lugs las nyams so zhes smra ba yang mi 'thad de/ grub chen 'di'i gdams ngag tu/ chos thams cad sems su sgrub pa/ sems sgyu mar sgrub pa/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa gsum gsungs nas phyi ma 'di la/ rten 'brel du sgrub pa dang*/ brjod bral du sgrub pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ kha ton dang mar me la sogs pa dbu ma nas bshad pa'i rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis sngar gyi sgyu mar 'dzin pa'i blo de rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsam du sgrub pa yin la/ rten 'brel gyi don ni stong pa nyid la bya ste/ dbu ma rtsa bar/ rten cing 'brel 'byung gang yin pa// de ni stong pa nyid du 'dod/

rnam pa gcig tu na rten 'brel bsgrub par byas nas brjod bral yin pa'i phyir gyi gtan tshigs 'god pa min kyang*/ rten 'brel gyi don yang brjod pa dang bral ba zhig la bya'o// zhes ston la de tsam smras pas dbu ma pa las nyams na/ klu sgrub kyis kyang rten 'brel gyi don stong nyid la bya bar gsungs pas klu sgrub kyang dbu ma pa ma yin par 'gyur ro// de 'dod na grub chen 'di dbu ma pa yin zer na'ang ngan rgyu med do/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug la sogs pa rnal 'byor bla med nas bshad pa'i brjod bral gyi dpes sngar gyi sgyu mar 'dzin pa'i blo de brjod bral tsam du sgrub pa yin la/ brjod bral gyi don yang*/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la bya ste/ grub chen ḍom+bi pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos rang bzhin// rtags nyid grub par brjod pa nyid// lhan cig skyes gyur de yi phyir// brjod bral lhan cig skyes par brjod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na sgyu ma de rten 'brel dang*/ brjod bral gyi dpes rang bzhin med par sgrub pa yin gyi/ rten 'brel brjod bral du sgrub pa ni/ nam yang min par shes par bya'o// rgol ba gsum pa 'bras bu'i skabs su gnas gyur khas len pa'i phyir sems tsam pa yin/ zhes pa'ang rnam par ma dpyad pa ste/ grub chen 'dis rang bzhin rgyu'i ngos nas lhun grub yin pa'i phyir/ gnas gyur mi bzhed la/ yon tan la ltos nas rten dkyil 'khor bzhi gnas gyur pa las 'bras bu sku bzhi 'byung bar bzhed do// 'di ji lta ba bzhin du 'phags pa yab sras sogs dbu ma pa rnams kyang bzhed de/ ngo bo nyid dam chos nyid la ltos nas gnas gyur pa med de/ chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro// de la dgongs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rtsa ba'i shes rab la sogs pa rnams las gnas gyur pa med par bshad do// yon tan la ltos nas gnas gyur pa yod de/

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa'i phyir ro// de la dgongs nas 'phags pas chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las gnas gyur pa yod par bshad do// des na 'phags pa'i gsung gnyis po de yang 'di ltar rtogs na mi 'gal bar 'gyur gyi/ gnas gyur mi 'dod pa kho na 'phags pa'i dgongs pa yin na/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ gnas 'di yongs su gyur pa na// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// zhes bshad pa dang nang 'gal bar thal ba'i skyon yod do// mdor na klan ka 'di gsum gyi skyon spong legs par shes na/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bshad pa rnams dbu mar bsnyon med du grub pa yin no// mdor na lam 'di gsal bar mdzad pa po ni/ sems tsam gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal ldan chos skyong gnas gyur pa'i dbu ma pa'i grub chen slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa zhes bya ba lam 'bras dang*/ shin tu spros med dang*/ do ha seṅge la sogs pa mdzad mkhan de yin te/ lam 'bras dang shin tu spros med gnyis po gdams ngag gi gnad shin tu mthun pa'i phyir dang*/ shin tu spros med las/ slob dpon dpal ldan mthu stobs kyi mgon po/ thugs spros pa med pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ sku'i spros pa dpag tu med pas gdug pa can tshar gcod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pas mdzad pa zhes mthu stobs dbang phyug tu gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// de la kha shangs pa kun mkhyen pa/ cig na re/ lam 'bras dang spros med gnyis mdzad pa po gcig na/ de dag gi dgongs pa sems tsam du gnas te/ spros med las/ 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang*// rig pa de nyid ma 'gags pa// rang rig ye shes skad cig ma// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// zhes smra'o// 'di ni shin tu mi 'thad de/

gzhung der/ khams med kun gzhi'i rnam shes med// ces kun gzhi bden par grub pa 'gog par byed pas na/ kun gzhi bden par grub pa 'gog pa'i sems tsam gyi gzhung ni shin tu ngo mtshar ba zhig go /rang rig tsam zhig khas blangs pas sems tsam par 'gyur na/ slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyang sems tsam par 'gyur te/ rang rig tsam zhig zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir ro// rtags grub ste/ gsang 'dus rim lnga las/ rang rig tsam gyi ye shes las// nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med// ces dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron me las/ de ltar na rnam par shes pa ni kha dog med pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ dbyibs med pa'i bdag nyid can/ rang rig tsam du theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las bstan no// zhes dang*/ 'di na lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa rnam pa gsum po de ni yid kyi dbang po ste/ dbang po thams cad kyi bdag po yin zhing so so rang rig pa yin pas/ zhes dang*/ 'gro ba med pa 'ong ba med// 'gag med rab tu zhi ba med// rtag dang chad pa rnam spangs pa// dus gsum mkhyen pas ma byas pa'i// so so rang rig mtshan nyid do// zhes dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni lus med pa/ dpe med pa/ rtsol ba thams cad dang bral ba so so rang gis rig pa ste/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ rang rig ston pa'i gzhung du mar gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// des na grub chen brgyad cu'i bstod par/ chu bo chen po gyen la bzlog /chang la nyi ma gteng par bcug /bir+wa pa zhes bya ba yi// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bshad pa ltar gyi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa de yin gyi/ phag mo dbu bcad ma dang*/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor sogs kyi gdams ngag mdzad mkhan gyi slob dpon/ rgyal rigs dman pa'i spyod pa mdzad// dur khrod nyul zhing sha chen gsol// bir+wa pa zhes bya ba yi// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa gnyis 'khrul bar mi bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

dang po na len+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad pa'i dus/ slob ma grangs med pa zhig yod pa ni gtso bor pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sgo nas smin par byas pa yin la/ phyis grub pa thob nas/ sngags kyi sgo nas smin par byas pa'i slob ma ni/ ko mkhan phyi bzhin du 'brangs pa grub chen ḍom+bi he ru ka dang*/ bi me ha sa'i yul gyi ral pa can lnga brgya'i nang nas gcig phyir 'brangs pa slob dpon nag po pa ste/ gnyis po 'di kho

bshad sgrub kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa 'di gnyis las ma byung bas de skad smos la/ gzhan du mthu stobs kyis phyi nang med pa dbang du gyur pas chos 'brel yod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o// na yin no// gsum pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gnyis kyis lam rgyas bsdus gnyis bshad tshul/ de gnyis bshad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru kas/ bskyed rim la bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od/ rdzogs rim la lhan cig skyes grub/ lam gyi yan lag la tshogs kyi 'khor thun mong ma yin pa'i don la gdams pa zhes gsungs/ lo 'du ba bsgrags pa dang bcas pa de nyid bcu pa rnams mdzad do// kye rdo rje lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ slong mo pa'i 'grel pa dang gsum ni/ nā ro pa'i slob ma dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pas mdzad kyi/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa ma yin no// de'i slob ma grub chen a la la badz+ras/ sku rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon rtogs/ phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'dis gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i mngon rtogs kyang rigs 'gre zhes mkhan po chos rjes gsungs/ zhes bya ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma nags khrod pas gzhung mdzad pa mi snang la/ de'i slob ma slob dpon gar+bha ri pas sku rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon 'dis cho ga gsum bskyed kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i mngon rtogs 'bring po gsum bskyed kyi dran pa gcig pa thams cad rigs 'gre gsungs/ rtogs dran pa gcig pa zhes pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma slob dpon bsod snyoms pas/ bdag med ma dpa' mo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad cing*/ gong ma rnams las rim par brgyud pa'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas/ sngar smos pa'i gzhung bdun po mdzad do// de'i slob ma dge slong dpa' bo rdo rjes/ dkyil chog bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ rab gnas/

sbyin sreg ro sreg tshogs 'khor/ gtor ma/ mchod pa'i cho ga rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ dkyil 'khor kye rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa zhes gsungs/ gyi cho ga rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba mdzad do// slob dpon des rje btsun 'brog la gdams so// gzhung de rnams kyi gtso bo ni 'grel pa ku mu ti yin pas gtso che ba la ming du btags nas/ lugs 'di la 'grel pa lugs sam/ ḍom+bhi lugs zhes bya'o// gzhung de rnams kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i lam gyi rim pa ni/ dang por bzang po yongs bzung las 'byung ba ltar dbang bskur ba'i cho gas rgyud smin par byas/ de'i 'og tu sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa ltar bskyed rim bsgoms pas tha lam gyi snang zhen bzlog par byas nas/ de'i 'og tu lhan cig skyes grub nas 'byung ba ltar/ rdzogs rim rang byin brlab dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis bsgoms pas/ bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la bskyed nas/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor bar bzhed de/ lugs 'di smin grol gyi lam thams cad shin tu bsdus la/ rgyud kyi bshad pa ni shin tu rgyas pa zhig snang ngo*// yang slob dpon nag po pa de'i slob ma ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ rje btsun ga ya dha ra/ bla chen 'brog mi'i bar du/ bla ma snga ma snga ma'i snyan brgyud phyi ma phyi ma rnams la bshad cing*/ nyams su len pa ma gtogs gzhung yi ger bkod pa med pas man ngag lugs sam/ nag po pa'i lugs zhes grags la/ 'di dag gi gdams ngag snyan brgyud rnams yi ger bkod pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam/ rje btsun chen po'i dkar chag tu bkod pa rnams yin pas lugs 'di la gzhung 'di rnams rgya gzhung lta bur khas blangs dgos pa yin no// tshul 'di'i lam gyi rim pa ni gang zag gi bkri tshul mang po zhig yod kyang*/ 'dir gang zag sngar lam la gtan 'jug ma myong ba blo dman pa zhig gi dbang du byas nas/

thog mar pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang thun mong du snang ba gsum gyi lam la blo sbyangs/ de'i 'og tu dbang bskur ba'i cho gas rgyud smin par byas/ de'i skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung*/ de'i 'og tu kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi lam gyis phyi nang gi chos thams cad skye med tu gtan la ma phebs kyi bar la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad cing sgom/ de'i 'og tu phyi bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi sgo nas snang ba'i dngos po lhar ma shar gyi bar du bsgom/ de nas nang bskyed pa'i rim pa lus dkyil gyi rnal 'byor gyis phyi rol gyi spros pa nang du ma chod kyi bar du sgom/ de nas rlung dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ phyag rgya'i lam dang*/ rba rlabs kyi rnal 'byor gyis rdzogs rim gyi ye shes rgyud la bskyed nas/ tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu mngon du byed la/ gal te ma grub na bar do dang*/ des ma grub na 'pho ba la sogs pa'i gdams ngag gis kyang 'bras bu mngon du byed cing*/ ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ skyes pa bogs 'byin pa/ lam gyi gegs sel tshul sogs/ rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba'i rim pa shin tu rgyas shing rgyud kyi bshad pa ni man ngag dang sbyar te 'bru gnyer ba tsam dang*/ dka' gnas 'ga' zhig gi bshad pa tsam ma gtogs pa rgyas pa mi snang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gnyis char grub chen bir+wa pa'i slob ma yin pa la lam gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rje btsun bir+wa pa nyid kyis ḍom+bi pa la lam bsdus pa dang*/ nag po pa la lam rgyas pas bkris pas na/ rang ji ltar bkris pa bzhin slob ma rnams la'ang bshad pas/ lam gnyis byung ba yin no// 'o na slob dpon gnyis la lam rgyas bsdus gnyis gsung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ spyir chos thams cad gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham par bstan dgos pa yin la/

gdul bya'i gang zag kyang gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi skal ldan cig car du 'jug pa dang*/ skal dman rim gyis 'jug pa gnyis su nges so// de la dang po ni/ dang po nyid nas lam gzhan la slob mi dgos par smin byed nas brtsams te/ rdzogs rim gyi bar lam gyi gtso bo rnams nyams su blangs pas grol ba'i gang zag gcig la de dang mthun par lam ston pa la bya la/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po nyid du gsang sngags la mi mos shing*/ blo tha mal par gnas pas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas yid skyo bar byed dgos la/ skyabs 'gro la sogs pa theg pa thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyangs nas/ sngags kyi lam la'ang rim gyis slob dgos pa'i gang zag gcig la de dang mthun par lam ston pa la bya'o// des na dang por lam la 'jug pa'i dus su ḍom+bhi pa blo rab dang*/ nag po pa blo tha ma zhig yod par snang bas/ de dang mthun par chos bstan pa yin te/ gdul bya dbang po rnon po la mdor bsdus pa dang*/ dbang po rtul po la rgyas par bshad dgos pa gsung rab thams cad las bshad pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ de ltar lam gnyis kyang rang gi ngo bo gcig yin te/ skal dman rim gyis 'jug pa'i gang zag cig ḍom+bhi pa'i lam gyis bkri dgos na/ nag po pas bshad pa ltar bkri ba las gzhan pa'i thabs med cing*/ skal ldan cig car ba zhig nag po pa'i lam gyis bkri na/ ḍom+bi pas ji skad bshad pa las gzhan du bshad du med pa'i phyir ro// des na gdul bya gang zag gi ngos nas gnyis su phye ba yin gyi/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas phye ba ma yin pas/ lam gnyis kyi don gcig tu shes par bya'o// gzhan yang rgyas pa'i nang du bsdus pa tshang ba chos nyid yin pas na/ man ngag lugs kyi nang du 'grel pa lugs kyi lam thams cad tshang ba yin no// gal te lam 'di gnyis don gcig na/ mi 'dra ba mi rigs pa la smin byed dang*/

bskyed rim gyi skabs na mi 'dra ba du ma snang ba'i phyir ro snyam na/ bshad par bya ste/ smin byed kyi skabs su bzang po yongs bzung gi sa chog yan chad la mi 'dra ba yod pa ni/ slob dpon des rdo rje gdan bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyud gzhan nas kha bskang ste/ spros pa la dga' ba'i ngor mdzad pa yin gyi/ dang po nas byung ba'i nyams len ma yin la/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sa chog yan chad ni man ngag lugs kyi dbang gi chu bo dang mthun zhing*/ dang po nas byung ba'i nyams len yin pas/ gnyis po gang byas kyang 'dra la/ gzhan du na 'grel pa lugs la'ang*/ smin byed kyi lam gnyis yod par thal ba'i skyon yod do// cho ga lhag ma rnams la rgyas bsdus ma gtogs don la khyad par ci yang med do// de bzhin du bskyed rim gyi skabs su'ang yan lag bdun pa'i tshig mi 'dra ba tsam dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas pa'i rjes la/ gnas gsum byin brlab sogs bya bar bshad pas ni/ lam gyi spyi mi 'dra bar 'byed mi nus te/ gal te nus na man ngag lugs la'ang lam gnyis su thal ba'i skyon yod de/ yan lag drug pa dang bzhi pa rgyun bshags kyi tshig mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang*/ dag pa dran pa'i rjes la bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ bzlas pa byas nas dag pa dran pa sogs go rim mi 'dra ba bshad pa'i phyir ro// mdor na nang gsel gyi dbye ba phra mos lam gyi spyi mi 'dra ba 'byed mi nus pas na/ 'grel pa lugs dang man ngag lugs gnyis ka rje btsun bir+wa pa'i lugs zhes spyi gcig tu shes par bya ste/ dper na/ slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying pos de nyid snang bar bshad pa'i rdor dbyings 'grel pa lugs dang*/ rdo rje 'byung bar bshad pa'i dkyil chog lugs gnyis/ lugs so sor grags shing nang gsel mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang gnyis char slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i lugs su gcig pa bzhin no// des na 'dir bshad pa dang nyams su blang bar bya ba'i lam ni/

dpal bir+wa pa yab sras gsum gyis legs par bkral ba'i shing rta'i srol chen po de yin no// zhes khong du chud par bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ mtshan bsgyur ba/ mtshan bshad pa/ zhar byung lo tsā bas phyag 'tshal ba'o// dang po ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na/ saṃ skṛ ta/ pra kri ta/ a ba bh+raṃ sha ta/ pi sha tsi ka ste/ skad rigs bzhi las/ legs par sbyar ba saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du/ sgrub thabs 'di la/ ṣaṭa am̐ ga sā dha nam̐ na ma/ zhes bya la de bod kha ba can pa'i skad du bsgyur na/ yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba ste/ de yang ṣaṭa ni drug aṃ ga ni yan lag sā dha naṃ ni sgrub pa'i thabs/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur le'u bzhi par bshad pa ltar/ bskyed rim yan lag drug bsgoms pas 'bras bu rgyal ba rigs lnga/ rdo rje 'chang dang drug sgrub par byed pa'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa ston pas de skad ces bya ste/ brjod zhes pa ni brjod bya bskyed rim yin la/ de'i sgrub thabs kyi ming la mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba las/ 'dir yan lag drug gi 'ching ba las mtshan de la btags so// bya la mtshan du btags pa'o// yang gzhung gzhan dang bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ kye rdo rje ni thabs shes gnyis su med pa ste/ bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu'o// mngon par ni 'bras bu'i kye rdo rje la mngon du phyogs te 'gro ba'i lam mo// rtogs pa ni 'bras bu dang lam gyi don rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa lung dang rtogs pa zhes gnyis su grags pa rtogs pa'i yon tan la bya'i/ yul khong du chud pa'i don la skabs 'dir mi bshad do// gsum pa ni/ phyag 'tshal ba'i yul nges don dang drang don gnyis las dang po ltar na/ dpal zhes pa gzhung na med kyang*/ rten 'brel gyi 'di la spyir gyi sa skya pas/ rtsa rgyud du shrī he badz+ra tan+t+ra rā dzā zhes dang*/

yig brgya'i dbur shrī he ru ka zhes dang*/ gur mgon gyi rtsa sngags kyi dbur/ shrī mahā ka la zhes dpal gsum bcug pas rten 'brel legs zhes pa'ang yin mod/ de rnams dang 'dir yang dpal bcug pa ni/ he badz+ra zhes pas snying rje dang*/ stong pa gnyis ston pa las/ de gnyis dbyer med du rtogs shing 'chad pa la shrī nges par dgos pas/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de nyid nges don gyi kye rdo rjer bshad pa'i bshad gzhir rtogs pa'o// che bas bcug ste bshad na/ dpal ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ rtsa rgyud las/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// zhes so// gang gnyis su med na thabs dang shes rab ste/ de la thabs ni/ kye zhes bya bas snying rje bstan te/ sems can dang*/ chos dang*/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje gsum las 'dir brjod bya'i gtso bo sems can dang chos su rnam par mi rtog pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje mthar thug pa ste/ des zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas so// shes rab ni rdo rje zhes pas bstan te/ de'ang dper na/ rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam/ tshur gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus la phar dngos po thams cad 'joms pa ltar/ shes rab stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa 'dis kyang*/ phar dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad 'joms la tshur gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus te/ rdo rje rtse mor/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// bcad dang gzhig par bya ba med// bsreg par byar med 'jig med pa// stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'dis srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'o// thabs shes rab de gnyis kyang zag pa med pa'i dbyings su/ dper na/ mar me'i snang ba dang*/ dro mdog so so ma yin zhing*/ rnam pa dbyer med par gyur ba ni gnyis su med par gyur pa ste/ rgyud bla mar/ dri med gnas la mngon shes dang*// ye shes dri med de nyid ni// rnam dbyer med phyir mar me yi// snang dang dro mdog chos mtshungs can// zhes pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i thabs shes dbyer med de nyid la/

nges don gyi dpal kye rdo rje zhes bya ste/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye yi rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes so// gnyis pa ltar na/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa'i rnam pa can ni drang don gyi dpal kye rdo rje ste/ yul de dag la/ sngon rje btsun 'brog mi lots+tsha ba la sogs pa'i 'gyur byed rnams dang*/ rjes 'jug bshad sgrub byed pa rnams kyis sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// gsum pa sgrub thabs dngos la gsum/ sgrub thabs la 'jug pa'i yan lag yan lag can gyi sgrub thabs dngos/ sgrub thabs mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ yi dam lha dang*/ bla ma la mchod par brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ bzhugs zhes drangs nas/ gnas gang du na/ dkyil 'khor sgyu ma sogs te/ de la spyir dkyil 'khor la gnyis las/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ dngos po thams cad kyi gnas lugs de ni snying po yin la/ de dga' ba dang*/ skad cig ma bzhi la sogs pa'i thabs kyis len par byed pas na/ dkyil 'khor te/ rtsa rgyud las/ dkyil ni snying po zhes bya ste// byang chub sems ni bde chen po// len par byed pas dkyil 'khor nyid// 'dus pa dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod// ces so// kun rdzob kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa ni snying po yin la/ de yan lag drug la sogs pa'i bskyed rim gyi sgo nas len par byed pas na/ dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'o// snga

kre zhing sna ra ba a sang kīrti/ rabs pa kha yo ga pa cig dkyil gtso bo dang*/ 'khor lha mo dang*/ yang kha cig dkyil lha dang*/ 'khor gzhal yas khang du 'dod pa rnams ni sngar gyi lung dang 'gal lo// de ltar dkyil 'khor gnyis las/ skabs 'dir kun rdzob kyi dkyil 'khor ston te/ de la sgyu ma ni/ sngags dang sman la sogs pa las byung bas snang yang bden pa med pa ltar/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang pa yang*/ rgyu 'byung bzhi la sogs pa las byung bas de ltar snang yang*/ dpyad na rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs zhes pa'o// grogs su dang lhan cig tu na/ chu zla dang mtshungs sogs te/ ji ltar chu nang gi zla bas zla ba'i don byed mi nus pas bden pa min la/ snang tshod du snang bas brdzun pa ma yin pa ltar brten pa lha rnams kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa la snang ba'i cha nas brdzun pa ma yin la/ de nyid brtags na ma grub pas bden pa min pa chu zla dang mtshungs pa'i lha mo brgyad dang lhan cig tu'o// ngo bo gang bzhugs na/ gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi bdag po dpal kye rdo rje don stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa rnam par thar pa brgyad dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang*/ de bzhin nyid de stong pa nyid bcu drug la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa de nyid gzugs kyi sku rnam thar brgyad dag pa'i zhal dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dag pas zhabs dang*/ de bzhin nyid bcu drug dag pas phyag bcu drug dag pa'i rnam pa can gyi lha de'o// de nyid gzhal yas khang pa'i nang gi gang du bzhugs zhe na/ bdud kyi snying ga nyams dga' ba ste/ nges don du phung po la sogs pa'i bdud bzhi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rjes bcom pa de nyid/ drang don du gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i snying ga nyams dga' ba'i gnas su'o// tshul ji ltar na dmigs med kyi snying rjes 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du/

sems can gyi don mdzad pa la/ dgyes par gyur pa'i tshul gyis so// rnam pa ji lta bur bzhugs na/ gar mkhan ltar skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing*/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas sku mdog nam mkha' lta bur sngo ba ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ nga rgyal can rnams spa bkong ba'i phyir dregs par mdzad pa'i rnam pas so// de ltar na gtso bo bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal gyi/ 'gro ba gsum po rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las srungs shig ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ de dag gi sprul pa'i sku ni kye rdo rje yin la/ de dang 'dra ba ni yi dam dang tha mi dad cing*/ 'gro ba rnams skye ba dang*/ rga ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po bzhi las sgrol bar byed pa'i theg pa gcig pa ste/ bzhon pa'am/ gru'am/ gzings su gyur pa ni/ bla ma dza ya shrī shān+ti ste/ de la sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar phyag 'tshal nas ci byed ce na/ brtsam par bya/ zhes sbrel lo// gang brtsams na thur ma lta bu 'di ni brtsam par bya ba'o// ci'i phyir thur ma yin zhe na/ mi shes pa'i sgrib g.yogs mun pa dang 'dra ba de 'dral ba yis te sel bar byed pa'i phyir ro// de yang dper na gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po gsal bar byed pa ni/ mig gi dbang po yin la/ de rab rib mthug pos g.yogs te/ mun par gyur nas gsal bar mi nus pa de/ gser gyi thur mas rab rib bsal ba'i dus na/ gzugs sogs gsal bar blta nus pa bzhin/ sems can gyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yod kyang*/ sgrib gnyis kyis g.yogs pas mun pa lta bur gyur pa de/ sgrub thabs kyi thur ma 'dis sel bar byed ces pa'i don to// 'o na thur ma lta bu de'i ming ci zhe na/

kye rdo rje dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag drug pa zhes bya'o// 'o na de rang bzor brtsams sam zhe na/ ma yin te/ grub chen ḍom+bhi pa'i zhal snga nas kyi man ngag rnams slob dpon a la la badz+ra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa/ grub thob gar+bha ri pa/ rje btsun bsod snyoms pa rnams las rim pa bzhin du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can rnyed pas de la brten nas so// kha ri bo dga' ldan pa/ cig slob dpon 'di ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i dngos slob du 'dod pa ni bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa tsam yang ma mthong zhing*/ gzhung 'dir ḍom+bhi'i zhal snga nas kyi 'di la rgol ba de dag na re/ rim zhes pa bskyed rim rnyed ces 'bru gnon te/ de ltar na rdzogs rim rnyed ces kyang brjod du rung ste tshig la 'khri bar zad do// rim rnyed pa/ zhes pa'i tshig la'ang dpyad pa ma zhugs par zad do// 'o na bla ma brgyud pa'i gdams ngag de'ang rang bzo min nam zhe na/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud chen po rgya mtsho lta bu la brten nas brtsams pa'o// de'i phyir rtogs pa'i zhes sbrel te/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag bar ma chad pa rtogs shing khong du chud pa la brten nas kye rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ thur ma lta bu 'di brtsam zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no// dang po ni/ sgrub thabs 'dis brjod bya'i don ci zhig ston snyam na/ bskyed rim gtso bor gyur pa'i rim pa gnyis ston cing*/ der rnal 'byor bla med kyi nyams len thams cad kyang 'dus pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni// rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid// rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// rdo rje can gyi chos 'chad do// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi mar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten// bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang*// de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim nyid do// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// gal te rdo rje can gyi chos thams cad rim gnyis su 'du na/

rgyu rgyud dang 'bras rgyud gnyis der ji ltar 'du snyam na/ de la rgyu rgyud ni/ rim gnyis kyi sbyang gzhi yin la/ dbang bskur ni sngon 'gro dang*/ 'bras bu sku gnyis ni thob bya yin pas der 'du'o// des na rim gnyis spyi'i don bshad par bya ba la drug rim gnyis kyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ nges tshig grangs nges pa/ grol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ go rim nges pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ thabs khyad par can gyis mtshan rtog las yid skyob pa'o// gnyis pa ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis so// gsum pa la gsum/ gtso bor sbyang gzhi la dang*/ gtso bor 'bras bu la dang*/ gtso bor lam la ming du btags pa'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis bzhed pas sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi rim pa gnyis te/ de la sbyang gzhi bskyed rim la/ bskyed pa ni tha mal gyi lus grub pa yin la/ rim pa ni/ skye ba'i rim pa skye gnas bzhi dang*/ bye brag tu mngal skyes ltar na/ mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'o// de sbyong byed kyi bskyed rim ni lha'i rnam pa'o// sbyang gzhi rdzogs pa ni/ tha mal gyi sems can tshe zad nas 'chi ba yin la/ rim pa ni/ sa chu la thim pa sogs 'chi ba'i rim pa'o// de sbyong byed kyi thabs rdor bzlas dang*/ 'od gsal sogs ni sbyong byed rdzogs rim yin no// zhes bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ sems 'grel rnams kyi dgongs pas bskyed pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir thun mong gi dngos grub yin la/ de sgrub byed kyi thabs lha'i rnam pa bsgom pa la rim pa zhes bya'o// rdzogs pa ni/ de las 'bras bu gong na med pas mchog gi dngos grub yin la/ rim pa ni de sgrub byed kyi thabs sbyor ba yan lag drug yin no// zhes bzhed do// gsum pa ni/ grub chen bir+wa pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pas lam la ming gtso bor btags te/ blos kun tu lha'i rnam pa bskyed pa ni/

bskyed pa yin la/ de rim gyis gsal 'debs pa ni rim pa yin no// rdzogs pa ni lus ngag yid gsum rdzogs par gsal 'debs pa ste/ rang byin brlab dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa yin la/ rim pa ni de nyid rim gyis bsgom pa'o// de ltar na rgyu sbyang gzhi dang*/ 'bras bu'ang rim gnyis su shes par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ de lta bu'i lam de gnyis char bsgom mam/ gang rung zhig bsgoms pas chog snyam na/ gnyis ka bsgom dgos te/ 'di'i 'thad pa la gsum/ spang bya gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang*/ thob bya gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i phyir rim pa gnyis ka bsgom dgos pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang*/ gya nom lhar zhen pa'o// dang po ni/ spang bya tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyong ba'i phyir bskyed rim dang*/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rtog pa sbyong ba'i phyir rdzogs rim bsgom pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ phal pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir// bsgom pa yang dag rab tu grags// rang bzhin gnas skabs bsgom pa las// bsgom pa ma yin mi bsgom min// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtogs pa de bzhin te/ 'on kyang mi gtsang ba'i tshad mnyam par sbyong ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes bshad do// de la mi gtsang ba'i tshad tha mal gyi rnam rtog la gnyis/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'o// dang po sbyong ba ni/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa yin la/ gnyis pa bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa ni/ snod bcud gnyis te/ de la snod sbyong ba ni/ 'byung bzhi las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa ltar na gdan no// bcud sbyong ba la gnyis/ bskyed chog gis skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul dang*/ lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'khor bar skye ba'i gnas ni/

skye gnas bzhi yin la/ de sbyong byed bskyed chog kyang bzhi ste/ de'ang dkyil 'khor gcig la sbyar na/ mngon byang lnga las/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i nyi ma drod/ zla ba gsher te/ drod gsher skyes sam nyi zla gnyis kyis khu khrag gnyis mtshon pas mngal skyes kyi blo sbyong ngo*// 'khor rnams mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes dang*/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin thig le'i gong bu las bzhengs pas sgong skyes dang*/ skye mched kyi lha skad cig gam sa bon las bskyed pas rdzus skyes dang*/ mthar dkyil 'khor bsdu bas ni snod bcud 'jig pa sbyong ngo*// lha so so'i bskyed chog la sbyar na/ mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa ni/ drod gsher skyes dang mngal skyes sbyong*/ rdo rje cho ga gsum dang bzhi dang*/ thig le las bzhengs pas sgong skyes dang*/ dbugs 'byung rngub dang snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pas rdzus skyes dang*/ 'khor gyi lha mngal 'byin rnams kyis mngal skyes kyi blo sbyong ste/ de ltar skye gnas bzhi sbyong zhing tshogs gnyis bsags nas lha'i sku bsgoms pas 'bras bu 'grub pa'i lam 'di ni sbyang gzhi sbyong zhing 'bras bu 'grub pa'i lam zhes bya ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ shin tu zab pa'i bskyed rim khro chags kyi rnam pa can gyis nyon mongs pa dug gsum sbyong ste/ de yang khro bo'i skur bzhugs pas zhe sdang dang*/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pas 'dod chags dang*/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs kyi skur bsgoms pas gti mug sbyong ste/ rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal ser sna'i skye bo rnams// bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la// rdo rje'i gzugs ni du ma 'dzin// zhes so// de ltar khro chags kyi skur bsgoms pas/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs gsum zhi bar byas nas/ gzhan rnams shugs la zhi bar byed pa yin la/ khro chags kyi rnam pa med pa'i bskyed rim rnams ni cung zad mi zab pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/

gya nom lhar zhen pa'i rnam rtog ni rdzogs rim gyis sbyong ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi// brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom// spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas// spros pa nyid ni spros med byed// ces so// gzhan yang rdzogs rim 'dis ni/ sbyang gzhi tha mal pa mtha' dag sbyong ste/ sam+bu ṭa las/ rnam rtog gti mug chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur// zhes so// yang rang byin rlabs dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i ye shes skye ba'i rten 'byung bzhi las grub pa'i rtsa la sogs pa rnams kyis ni ma dag pa'i snod bcud sbyong la/ de la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes kyis ni brten pa yid sbyong ngo*// yang rdzogs rim gyi ye shes kyis ni sbyang gzhi rten dang brten pa 'jig pa'i tshul sbyong ste/ 'chi ba'i dus su sa chu la thim/ chu me la thim/ me rlung la thim/ rlung nam mkha' la thim/ nam mkha' rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags rnams rnal 'byor pas rdzogs rim sgom pa'i skabs su'ang 'byung ste/ rdo rje gur las/ dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste// gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba yin// gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ste// bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste// sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid// ces so// mdor na bskyed pas kun rtog sbyong la/ de nyid rdzogs pas sbyong ba dang*/ bskyed pas skye ba sbyong la/ rdzogs pas 'chi ba sbyong ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs re res kyang skye 'chi dang*/ snang stong dang*/ rnam rtog mtha' dag sbyong ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rim gyis gzugs kyi sku thob par byed la/ rdzogs rim gyis chos sku thob par byed de/ dang po'ang*/ rdo rje gur las/ de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes// thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste// sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid du myur bar 'grub// ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// de ni thabs kyi gzugs can no// zhes gsungs pas/

lha'i sku sgom pa'i rnal 'byor de dag de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas pa dang mthun te/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa dang 'dra/ de bzhin du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni srod la bdud btul ba/ gzhal yas khang ni ma dag pa'i snod sbyangs te/ 'og min du byin gyis brlabs pa/ mngon byang lngas lha'i rnam par grub pa ni/ 'og min nam rdo rje gdan gyi steng du tho rangs sangs rgyas pa/ dbang bskur ba ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu ni sems can gyi don byed pa/ bzlas pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ bskyed rim bsdus te stong nyid bsgom pa ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang 'dra ste de ltar mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad nas/ slar yang mdzad pa rgyun mi chad pa dang 'dra bar stong nyid kyi ngang las/ lha'i skur langs nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don byed pa yin no// gnyis pa rdzogs rim bsgoms pas ni/ chos sku thob par byed de/ sam+bu ṭa las/ rang byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni// chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags// zhes dang*/ gur las/ chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba// gang zhig gnas pa de bas na// sems can sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur// zhes te/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams zung 'jug ngo bo nyid dang mthun pa rnams chos sku dang mthun par mos shing bsres la bsgoms pas chos sku lam du byed pa'o// de ltar rim gnyis bsgoms pas 'bras bu sku gnyis 'grub pa de'ang*/ lan cig de lta bu 'grub pa la da lta nas de lta bu goms pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya/ de'ang 'bras bu'i rnam pa tsam yin pas rnam pa lam du byed pa zhes bya ste/ rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do// gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor 'di// de yi bde ba bde chen brjod// rdzogs pa sgom pa med pa ste// bskyed pa yis ni ci zhig 'tshal// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/

rdzogs rim gyis bskyed rim nyid kyang sbyong zhing*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'grub na de kho nas chog pas bskyed rim bsgom pa don med do snyam nas zhus pa'o// de'i lan du rdzogs rim de ltar bzang yang de la bskyed rim med na de nyid kyang mi 'byung zhes dpe dang bcas te ston pa ni/ e ma byang chub sems dpa' che// dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams// lus kyi dngos med gang las bde// bde ba smra bar mi nus so// khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyis ni// bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid// ji ltar me tog la gnas dri// me tog dngos med shes mi 'gyur// de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med na// bde ba nyid kyang dmigs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ rgyu'i gnas skabs su/ zhu ba med na bde mi 'gyur// nus pa med phyir ltos dang bcas// zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid// mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa// zhes 'byung la/ 'bras bu'i skabs su/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje snying po rnam pa med pa'i byang chub de skad mi smra zhig nga nyid dngos po dngos med nga*// dngos po de bzhin gshegs pas brjod// gzugs med gzugs dang ldan pa'i mchog /zab mo zhi ba'i gzugs dang ldan// zhes so// de bzhin du lam rim pa gnyis kyang rten dang brten pa yin pas zung 'brel du nyams su blang bar bya'o// lnga pa la gsum/ rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar rim gnyis bsgoms pas grol ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// rgyu ji ltar yin snyam na/ thams cad gsang ba las/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab cing*// 'bras bu la'ang rgyus rgyas gdab// ces gsungs pas/ spyir rgyu thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yin la/

'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa'ang rgyu'i rigs yin no// de bzhin du lam yang de gnyis kyi rigs yin la/ de gnyis kyang lam gyi rigs yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rigs dang 'byung ba lnga rnams dang*// phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyis// rigs dang bgrang bya 'di yis ni// rigs zhes mngon par brjod par bya// zhes so// de la lam gyi skabs 'dir/ 'bras bu ni rigs bdag yin la/ lam dang rgyu ni rigs yin pas// rigs dang rigs kyi bdag po mi 'bral zhing*// 'brel ba can du grub pa'i phyir// rim pa gnyis po 'dis grol bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis// skye po thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur// dug gi de nyid shes pa des// dug gis dug ni 'bigs bar byed// ces gsungs te/ dug gis dug la bsnun pa rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba dang*/ rlung gis rlung la bsnun pa ldog pa dang*/ chu yis chu 'gugs pa sbom pa dang*/ tshig pa mes gdung ba la bsnan pa gnyen por che ba bzhin du/ dri mas dri ma 'khrud pa'am/ rtog pas rtog pa zlog par byed de/ rtsa rgyud las/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// zhes te/ gong gi dpe bzhis/ spang bya de nyid thabs kyis zin na de nyid kyis grol te/ srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bur 'gyur zhes rtogs par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las// phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga// rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /ces te/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir grol lo// 'o na bsgoms pas ci bya snyam na/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sbyang bya// zhes te/ dri ma glo bur ba rnams sbyang zhes pa'i don to// de la rang bzhin gyis ji ltar dag de sbyong byed kyi gnyen po ni gang*/

de'i 'bras bu ni ji ltar 'gyur snyam na/ dang po ni/ dag pa gsum dang ldan te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i de bzhin nyid ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ sems can rnams kyi lus rang bzhin gyis dag pa/ zhal phyag gi rnam par grub pa ni/ lha so so'i dag pa/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa de nyid rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul du shes pa rang rig pa'i dag pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar rang bzhin gyis dag kyang*/ glo bur du gzung 'dzin du snang ba'i dri ma sbyong ba la/ thabs rgyud kyi dag pa gsum dgos pas/ des na lam bsgom par rigs so// de la de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa ni/ rtogs pa'i lta ba ste/ de bzhin nyid de la mos par byed pa'i phyir ro// lha so so ni rnam pa gzugs can sbyong bar byed pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rang rig pa ni thams cad sems yin pa de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar lam rim pa gnyis dag pa gsum ldan du bsgoms pas 'bras bu de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa mthar phyin pa chos kyi sku yin la/ lha so so'i dag pa mthar phyin pa ni gzugs kyi sku dang*/ rang rig pa'i dag pa mthar phyin pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin no// mdor na rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad dag pa gsum yin pa'i phyir/ rim pa gnyis kyis grol bar rigs zhes bya ba'i don to// drug pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras ni/ bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim sgom par bzhed de/ rim lnga las/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas nas// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi gdang bu lta bur gsungs// zhes bshad do// de bzhin du/ slob dpon ḍom+bi pa'i bdud rtsi 'od las kyang*/ bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim bsgom par gsungs so// sems 'grel pa rnams ni/ bskyed rim brtan rung mi brtan rung*/

bskyed rim lo bcu gnyis bsgoms nas gdod rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod do// slob dpon kha cig ni/ bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis rgyas btab nas bsgom par 'dod de/ legs par ma rtogs zhes rje btsun gsungs so// rje ga ya dha ra'i bzhed pas/ rtsa rgyud las/ rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// zhes gsungs pas/ gdan thog gcig tu rim pa gnyis ka bsgom ste/ thun stod la bskyed rim bsgoms nas thun smad la rdzogs rim bsgom par bzhed do// de ltar rim gnyis spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa 'di'i mtha' dpyod pa'i lung dang rigs pa du ma zhig mi dgos kha med du yod pa rnams ni mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bris la/ rang gi ngo bo rje btsun chen pos ji ltar bshad pa'i don bsdus te bris pa yin no// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la lnga/ gang gis sgom pa'i gang zag nam bsgom pa'i dus/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ji lta bus bsgom pa'i bsam pa/ gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs shing*/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ dbang bskur ba thob pa dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag rang dang gzhan gyi don du mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par 'dod pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'di yi 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam rnams bsgom par bya ste/ slob dpon nag po pas/ dang por re zhig sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gnod pas skyo bar gyur pa'i sems can gyi khams la dmigs la/ snying rje phul du byung ba'i ros gang ba'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems kyis/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la goms par byas pas dag par gyur pa'i sems kyi rgyun dang ldan pa dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing rjes su gnang ba thob pa/ dam tshig dang spyod pa la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pas zhes dang*/

sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las/ rnal 'byor pas sems can thams cad kyi don la brtson pa'i blos zhes bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ las dang po pas bsgom pa'i dus ni/ rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du nyung ba'i rten 'brel yin pas/ mtshan mo'i dus su bsgom ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan dus su zhes so// 'o na shān+ti pa dang*/ nyin 'byung zla bas/ nang par snga bar langs la zhes dang*/ nag po pa dang*/ mar me mdzad kyis tho rangs langs la/ zhes snga dro dang tho rangs nas bsgom par bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de ltar bris pa ni bshad bde ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'dir las dang po pa bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'i thog mar nges par mtshan mo'i dus nas bsgom dgos pa yin te/ shān+ti pa'i brtag gnyis kyi 'grel par mtshan mo'i dus la zhes pa ni/ skye bo rnams nyal ba'i dus su'o// zhes dang*/ nag po pa'i 'grel par mtshan mo zhes bya ba ni/ mtshan mo'i cha las te/ gzhan du ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis 'tshe ba'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ bha wa bha dra'i 'grel par/ mtshan dus su zhes pa ni/ mtshan mo nyid la dngos grub mang bar 'gyur bas so// zhes gsungs pas/ rtog pa nyung ba dang*/ bar chad nyung ba dang*/ dngos grub mang ba'i phyir na mtshan mor bsgom dgos so// cung zad brtan pas ni thun bzhi'i tshul gyis bsgom ste/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las/ de ltar thun tshod bzhi'i rim pas zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ dza lan+dha ri pas/ thun bzhir byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pas zhes pa ni/ tho rangs dang*/ nyi ma'i gung dang*/ phyi dro dang*/ mtshan mo ste bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// zhes so// rtsa rgyud las/ thun gsum du bshad pa'i don ni/ slob dpon nag po pa'i sgrub thabs las/ tho rangs dang*/ gung gi thun dang*/ phyi dro'i thun la bshad do// 'di dag kyang gang zag gi nus mi nus kyi bye brag gis thun bzhi dang gsum gnyis ka mi 'gal lo// brtan pa cher thob pas ni dus thams cad du bsgom ste/

rtsa rgyud las/ rkang pa 'khrud dang za ba dang*// 'thor 'thung so rtsi za ba dang*// tsan+dan gyis ni lag nyed dang*// smad g.yogs kyis ni rked 'gebs dang*// 'byung dang smra dang 'gro ba dang*// 'dug dang khro dang nyal ba dang*// bcom ldan 'das ma bsten pa dang*// shes rab brtul zhugs can nyid kyis// rnal 'byor ma ni rnam par bsgom// zhes gsungs so// shān+ti pas/ gal te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bla na med pa ji ltar na myur du skye snyam pa la/ sbyor ba'i khyad par las te de la rnal 'byor la dmigs pa'i khyad par bdag nyid bdag med rnal 'byor ma'i khyad par ram/ dges pa'i rdo rje bsgom pa'i khyad par skad cig ma rgyun mi chad par ro// zhes bshad do// gsum pa la gnyis/ gnas dngos dang*/ der spyod lam ji lta bus bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ las dang po pas bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang po goms par byed dus kyi// gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sems// gcig tu mnyam gzhag 'grub 'gyur ba'i// gnas ni bzang por nges par brtag /rang gi khyim du zhes gsungs pas// dben zhing rang dbang du gyur pa'i rang gi khyim dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa dang*// ri khrod dang ni sman ljongs su// zhes bshad pas dben zhing yid dga' ba'i gnas su bshad do// sems cung zad brtan pas ni/ dur khrod kho nar bsgom ste/ de la dgongs nas slob dpon mtsho skyes/ gnyis med rdo rje/ mar me mdzad/ kaṃ pa la rnams kyis dur khrod du bsgom par bshad do// brtan pa cher thob pa'i gnas ni gnyis te/ rnal 'byor pa'i ngos nas bshad pa dang*/ lha'i ngos nas bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang*// yang na dben pa'am bas mtha' ru// zhes sogs dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ gnas sum cu so gnyis sogs su bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/

dur khrod dang chu 'gram la sogs pa'i rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas de dag tu bsgom ste/ rdo rje gur las/ snying rje chen po kye rdo rje// nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang*// nags tshal skye bo med grong du// bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster// mtsho skyes rnam pa'i 'gram yid 'ong*// sku gdung zab mo'i mchod rten dang*// rkang 'thung rlon pa'i 'og tu ni// nga ni sangs rgyas dngos grub ster// tshong dus grong rdal nyid dang ni// yang thog rnam pa'i khyim du ni// rdo rje nyi ma brtan pa nga*// bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster// glu gar rab tu 'ching ba dang*// chang tshong ma yi khyim du ni// 'di ltar pad+ma gar mkhan nga*// bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster// rtag tu mgyogs 'gro zhon gyur te// res 'ga' lam du 'gro ba na// rta ni don yod brtan pa nga*// dngos grub rdo rje rnams ster ro// zhes gsungs so// gnas de dag kyang las dang po pa'i gnas ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ gnas 'ga' zhig du gnas na nad gzhi mi skye/ kha cig tu gdon gyi bar chad mi 'byung*/ kha cig tu ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ba ni yid du 'ong ba ste shis pa'i gnas so// zhes pa ltar/ yid dang mthun pa dang*/ dben pa dang*/ bkra shis pa'i gnas dang*/ rang gi khyim ste bzhir bshad/ sems cung zad brtan pas ni/ dur khrod la sogs par bsgom ste/ rje btsun rtse mos/ khyad par du dur khrod smos pa ni/ las dang po pas brtson 'grus myur du brtsam par 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par du bsngags pa'i gnas te/ zhes gsungs so// brtan pa cher thob pa'i gnas la ni nges pa med do// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su gnas pa rig ma dang bcas pa/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig bsten pa/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byas pas zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor bshams nas der maṇ+ḍal la/

kye rdo rje lha dgu bskyed cing mchod pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa las dang po pa'i bya ba ltar byed pa ni thun mtshams thams cad du de ltar bya ba yin pas thun mtshams kyi bya ba zhes kyang bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya/ phyi rol tshogs sog gi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya/ 'di sngon du song nas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bzhed pa la/ mkhas pa kha cig mtsho skyes kyi gzhung de'i don sngon 'gro'i gtor ma la 'chad pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ gzhung de'i rgya 'grel las/ de'i rjes la yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gtor ma dang mchod pa byas nas/ zhes mchod pa dang gtor ma gnyis ka bya bar bshad pa dang*/ mtsho skyes nyid kyis kyang de ltar thun tshod bzhi'i rim pas/ bstod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba can bsgom mo// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// des na rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i dang por mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor byed pa 'di ni grub chen bir+wa pa yab sras gsum gyi bzhed pa'ang yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos/ yan lag bzhi par/ cho ga'i rim pa dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs shing*/ rje btsun chen pos yan lag drug par/ sngon du 'gro ba mchod pa dang gtor ma sngon du song nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste zhes gsungs pas man ngag lugs la'ang bya dgos shing*/ slob dpon gar+bha ri pas/ dben dang rang dga'i rang khyim du// mtshan dus maṇ+ḍal khru gang par// dri dang me tog tshom bu dgram// gtor ma'ang 'byor pa'i tshad byas la// dad pas nges par bsgom bya ste// zhes gsungs pas/ ḍom+bi pa'i lugs la'ang nges par bya dgos par snang ngo*// slob dpon nag po pas/ kye rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs su/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa dang*/

gtor ma phul zhing gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes la tshad med bzhi bsgom pa man chad kyi bskyed rim bsgom par yang bshad do// de ltar mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor sngon du song nas gnas de'am/ bsam gtan gyi khang pa gzhan du'ang rung ste/ rin chen 'bar bar/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas phyir// sa phyogs nyams dga' yid 'ong bar// dri zhim byugs shing me tog dgram// bde ba'i stan la der gnas la// zhes gsungs pas/ sa phyogs dris byugs par me tog gcal du bkram ste/ shān+ti pa sogs kyis stan bde ba la 'dug ces pa tsam las ma bshad la/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rje'i sgrub thabs las sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bde ba'i gdan la zhes dang*/ kaṃ pa las kyang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stan la legs gnas pas// zhes sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ mar me mdzad kyi sgrub thabs las/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i stan la bsdad// ces bshad pa ni/ phyi ma cung zad bde ste/ 'di mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir ro snyam mo// de lta bu'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas nas bskyed rim bsgom dgos te/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas nas ni// bla ma sangs rgyas mchod par bya// zhes dang*/ gur dang bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad par/ bde ba'i stan la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ phyag gi lo ma ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyar byas la zhes bshad cing*/ mig sna rtser dbab la/ so cung zad ma 'byar ba/ lus mi yo bar gnas nas bskyed rim bsgom par bram ze bhṛng gi ras bde mchog gi sgrub thabs su bshad do// des na dgug gzhug dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dmigs bsal du bshad pa ma gtogs dus thams cad du lus gnad 'di lta bus bskyed rim bsgom mo// slob dpon bsod snyoms pas/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas par bshad pa ni rdo rje skyil krung mi nus pa'i dbang du byas kyi/

gzhan du na gur gyi rgyud dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// bzhi pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// 'dis yis las rnams thams cad byed// ces pa ltar/ 'grub pa'am mi 'grub snyam pa'i dogs pa'am/ bar chad dang gnod pa 'byung ngam snyam pa'i 'jigs pa'i sems med par dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba la sogs pa'i blos bskul nas/ thabs shes kyi lam khyad par can gyis bsam gtan bsgom par bya ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang*// 'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rnyed dka'// de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis// yid la byed pa'i mchog de bsgrub par bya// zhes pa ltar ro// lnga pa ni/ rje btsun gyis mngon rtogs ljon shing du/ sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor/ rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag dang gsum gyis/ rgyud gsum nas bshad pa'i bskyed rim mtha' dag sdud par bshad pas de ltar byas kyang rung mod/ 'dir rje btsun rtse mos yan lag bzhi pa dang rje btsun gyis yan lag drug par/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis kyis bsdus par bshad pa 'di shin tu legs shing*/ rje sa chen gyis kyang*/ de la mngon rtogs rnam gnyis te// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor ro// mnyam bzhag bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis dang*// ma bzhag rnam pa brgyad yin te// nyal dang ldang dang bzlas pa dang*// khrus dang kha zas gtor ma dang*// spyod lam rjes chags rnal 'byor brgyad// ces pa dang mthun pas/ de ltar du bshad par bya ba la gnyis/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ gzhung nas dngos su bshad pa'i cho ga'i rnal 'byor rnams bshad pa dang*/

ma bshad pa'i gnad kyi don kha bskang ste bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang gzhung gi don no// dang po la gsum/ bsgrub bya lha'i rnam gzhag sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi rnam dbye/ des de ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ spyir rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba/ de las kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ngos bzung ba/ de las phyag bcu drug pa gtso bor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ he ru ka bzhi/ bdag med ma dang lnga/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang drug 'byung ngo*// rdo rje gur las/ rigs bsdus dang*/ rigs rkyang gnyis/ dang po la rgyas pa lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu dang*/ bsdus pa lha nyer lnga ma gnyis 'byung ste/ le'u lnga par/ dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa'am// yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro// brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am// yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar// gang tshe dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yi// sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang*// lcags sgrog de bzhin dril bu nyid// 'jug pa'i sgo srung dgod par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rigs bsdus 'di gnyis kyang*/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad kyis dkyil 'khor lnga lngar 'gyur te/ gur las/ sangs rgyas mgon po gang nyid kyi// dbus su dkyil 'khor gang gyur pa// de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor brjod// snying po yongs bzung dkyil 'khor ro// zhes so// des na rgyud 'dir dngos su rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor lha dgu ma lnga/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa lnga/ bsdus pa lnga ste bco lnga/ bdag med ma bcu gsum ma dang*/ bco lnga ma gnyis te/ bcu bdun gsungs la/ he ru ka gsum la rgyud 'di na dpa' bo gcig pa las dkyil 'khor ma gsungs kyang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'khor kha bskangs nas dkyil 'khor gsum bya ste/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor nyi shu 'byung ngo*// de la bla ma'i man ngag gis/

dkyil 'khor drug cu rtsa gnyis su dbye ste/ mi bskyod pa la he ru ka bzhi yod pa bzhin/ rigs gzhan la'ang bzhi bzhi yod pas/ rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor nyi shu/ rigs bsdus rgyas pa nyi shu/ bsdus pa nyi shu/ bdag med ma'i gnyis te drug cu rtsa gnyis su bzhed par mngon rtogs ljon shing las bshad la/ de'i steng du gur rgyan las/ yang 'dir rigs bsdus pa la brgyad dang bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa yod pa bzhin du/ rigs rkyang pa la'ang bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang*/ brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs pa yod do// zhes sbyar na/ brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs pa nyi shu tham pa yod pas na/ bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa'ang nyi shu tham pa 'byung bas dkyil 'khor brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba yin no// zhes brjod kyang 'gal ba med do zhes bshad pas/ rigs rkyang bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha snga ma lnga la he ru ka bzhi'i dbye bas nyi shu 'byung la/ de ltar na gur las brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bshad do// sam+bu ṭa las/ he ru ka bzhi/ bdag med ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje dbyings/ drag po gdan can te/ dngos su dkyil 'khor brgyad 'byung la/ brtag pa dang po las/ gang gi gang yang lha'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bcug pa de'i mtshan du bstan par gyur pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni mkhas pas bsngags so// zhes gsungs pas/ rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas dkyil 'khor lngar 'gyur te/ de ltar na/ mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis so// 'o na gtso bo du ma 'pho bas dkyil 'khor de bas mang bar 'gyur ro snyam na/ rigs lnga kho na go 'pho ba yin gyi yum bzhi man chad kyi dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i lha rnams gtso bor 'gyur ba med de/ de dag ni las rgyas pa'i lha yin pa'i phyir ro// de'ang sam+bu ṭa las/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod kyi las rnams la/

'khor lo'i rgyal mo rnam par sgom par byed do// zhes so// 'o na sam+bu ṭa'i bdag med ma'i skabs kyi rgyu rdo rje 'chang mi bgrang ngam snyam na/ de ni rdo rje dbyings kyi khongs su bsdus pas mi bgrang ngo*// zhes mngon rtogs ljon shing du bshad do// de ltar rtsa brgyud las dkyil 'khor drug rdo rje gur las brgyad cu rtsa gnyis/ sam+bu ṭa las bcu gnyis te/ thams cad dril bas mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya tham pa 'byung ste/ 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis bzhed pa yin no// yang slob dpon gzhan gyi bzhed pa ltar na/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i lnga par/ snying po kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la mi mthun pa med pas dkyil 'khor gcig yin la/ slob dpon nag po pa sogs kyis gzhal yas khang gi nang du phyag bcu drug pa yab yum dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor yang gsungs pas/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor gnyis so// dang po'i le'u gsum par he ru ka gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa la mi mthun pa mang ste/ 'di la gnyis/ 'khor med pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ro// dang po ni/ slob dpon ā nan+da badz+ras/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du gtso bo rkyang pa bsgom par bshad pas/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum yin la/ 'di'i sku rdo rje la yum yod do// gnyis pa ni rtsa rgyud las/ sku rdo rje'i skabs su/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad yongs bskor nas/ zhes bshad pa'i 'khor gsung dang thugs rdo rje gnyis ka la'ang kha bskangs nas dkyil 'khor du byed pa la/ slob dpon mtsho skyes/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ a bha ya sogs kyis phyag bcu drug pa'i 'khor du gyur pa'i gau rī nag mo gri gug dang nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa sogs lha mo brgyad kyis bskor bar bzhed/ byang chub snying pos gau rī nag mo sogs kha dog phyag bcu drug pa bzhin la phyag mtshan g.yas kyi gri gug dang g.yon thod pa/

g.yon gyi gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin par 'dod de/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gsung bsdus par/ gau rī kha dog nag por 'gyur// tsau rī btsod kyi kha dog ldan// be tā lī ni btso ma'i mdog /margad mdog 'dra ghasma rī// in+d+ra nī mdog puk+ka sī// sha ba rī ni chu shel bzhin// tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni mkha' bzhin sngo// ḍom+bi nī ni sna tshogs mdog /ro yi steng na 'od 'bar zhing*// phyag gnyis dbu skra gyen du brdzes// spyan dmar zhal ni gcig dang ldan// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// phyag ni gcig na ka pā la// g.yas kyi phyag na gri gug go /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yang phyag g.yon na// rked pa stag gi pags pas g.yogs// zhes bshad do// slob dpon bha wa bha dras/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sku mdog phyag bcu drug pa dang 'dra ba la/ phyag mtshan mchod rdzas rnams 'dzin par 'dod de/ des mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis 'grel par/ de rnams kyi sku mdog dang gdan la sogs pa ni/ phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor las 'chad par 'gyur la/ khyad par gyi dbye ba ni phyag mtshan tsam mo zhes bshad do// de la phyag mtshan ni/ dkar mos ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// zhes dang*/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pa'i 'grel par/ ro langs mas chus gang ba'i bum pa dang*/ ghasma rī bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ ri khrod ma ro drug gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yung mo rlung gi grwa nas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan par bshad la/ lhag ma rnams kyi phyag mtshan mi gsal yang*/ gau rī zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// tsau rī nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje dang*// gdol pa mo ḍā ma ru 'dzin par gsal lo// slob dpon de thams cad kyang gzhal yas khang pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhed do// grub chen a la la badz+ra ltar na/
