sgo tshad gcig ma la lnga mnyam gsum gsum mnyam gcig ste/ dkyil 'khor spyi 'gro'i rta babs mi 'dra ba gsum bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ rab tu sgron gsal las/ rta babs kyi dpangs sgo tshad gnyis mar bshad kyang*/ snam bu sogs 'di ltar byed kyi gsal kha mi snang mod/ 'on kyang phreng bar bshad pa'i lnga mnyam gsum gsum mnyam sbyar na 'grig par snang ngo*// gzhan rgya gar ba'i gzhung phal mo che nas/ rta babs sgo tshad gcig mar gsungs pa mang zhing*/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa'ang 'di kho na bzhin yin pas de bshad na/ slob dpon shrād+dha ka ra wa rmas/ rta babs ya phubs dag la ni// cha gcig dor bar cha chen tshad// chur ni cha chen bzhi pa ste// skas la sogs pa ji bzhin 'gyur// rta babs cha gcig pad+mar gnas// chos kyi 'khor lo cha gnyis pa// chur dang zheng mnyam gdugs kyi tshad// cha gcig pa la yu ba byed// 'khor lo'i ngos gnyis thad kar ni// ri dwags gnyis ni mnyam gnas pa// rta babs la brten 'khor lor phyogs// shin tu 'byar min rgyang ring min// rdo rje rin chen yu ba can// de tshad ri dwags kyi rgyab tu// cha chung gcig dor thig la brten// rdo rje rin chen yu ba phyed// ba dan dril bur ldan pa yis// mdzes pa rta babs yin par 'dod// ces gsungs pas/ sgo'i steng nas cha phran gcig dor ba'i steng du rta babs dpangs su cha chen gcig pa/ rgyar snam bu 'og ma'i mtha' nas mtha'i bar la sgo tshad bzhi yod la/ snam bu gong ma gsum 'og ma 'og ma las g.yas g.yon gnyis nas cha phran re res thung du song ba ste/ snam bu steng ma la cha phran bcu yod pa de'i steng du chos 'khor gyi gdan gyi pad+ma/ dpangs su cha chung gcig rgya chos 'khor dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du chos 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa'am/ bcu gnyis pa chur zheng du cha chung gnyis yod pa/ de'i steng du gdugs cha chung gcig gi tshad la phyed gdugs ngo bo dang phyed yu ba la yod pa/

chos 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra gnyis chos 'khor la kha bltas shing*/ shin tu 'byar min rgyang ring min// zhes pa'i don ri dwags dang chos 'khor gyi bar na/ cha chung re re gnas pa la 'grel pas bshad do// ri dwags kyi dpangs kyi tshad ni cha phran gnyis yin la/ de nas cha phran gcig dor bar ba dan dril bu dang bcas pa yu ba la cha phran gcig steng cha phran gcig la phyed rdo rje/ phyed rin po cher byas la/ ba dan dang dril bu sna tshogs pa btags pas mdzes par byas pa'o// de la kha cig rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sgo las sum 'gyur rta babs te// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ slob dpon 'di dang*/ slob dpon la wa pa ltar na/ ka ba'i nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la rta babs kyi tshad du byas nas/ de la sgo las sum 'gyur du yod pa'i phyir ro// yang kha cig dpangs su sgo tshad gcig tu byed pa rgyud rnams las bshad pa med do snyam na/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ zlum po nang ma'i mtha' nas mtha'i bar la/ cha re bzhir bshad pa'i cha re ni/ de'i 'grel par cha chung re re bshad pas/ dbus nas rwa rtse'i bar la cha chen brgyad las med pa'i phyir rta babs dpangs su sgo tshad gcig ma las gzhan 'ong don med la/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ dha ri ka pa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la sogs pa rgya gar ba'i grub chen du ma zhig gis bshad la/ bye brag tu kye rdo rje'i dkyil chog rnams las kyang 'di kho na ltar 'byung ngo*// gal te rta babs sgo tshad gcig mar bshad pa yod na/ phreng ba las 'byung ba ltar/ mun snam med pa'i snam bu bcu gcig mar rigs kyi/ mu snam dang bcas pa'i snam bu bzhi mar mi rigs so// zhe na de ni ma yin te/ rta babs sgo tshad gcig ma la mun snam byed pa ni/ la wa pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil mchog tu bshad la/ snam bu bzhir byed pa ni/ shrad+dhās/ de gsum cha ni bzhi bzhir bya// lnga pa drug bdun brgyad pa yang*// de bzhin legs par bgo bya zhing*// zhes cha chen bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis/

rta babs kyi sa yin la de dag dum bu bzhi bzhir bgos nas bzhag pa'i phyir dang*/ 'grel par skas la sogs pa'i ming can gyis dbyibs kyi khyad par gang dag yod pa de dag tu 'gyur bar bya'o// zhes them skas kyi rnam pa can du bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ grub chen mtsho skyes kyis kye rdor dkyil chog las/ rta babs kyi snam bu bzhi pa'i phyogs na/ cha phyed logs kyi phye ba bzhi la/ gcig la dharma tsakra/ gcig la rdo rje rgya gram gyi rwa dbus ma/ de'i sna la pad+ma'i sdong bu nas gtad par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na sgo 'gram gyi phyi mtha' dang*/ sgo logs kyi phyi mtha' gnyis su/ rta babs kyi ka ba dpangs cha phran lnga pa/ ka rgyan dang bcas pa bzhi bzhi btsugs la de'i steng du sgo 'gram gyi phyi nas sgo logs kyi bar mdun du 'ong zhing*/ de nas sgo logs cig shos kyi bar ngos su song ba de nas sgo 'gram cig shos kyi bar rgyab tu song bar gyur gyi bar rdo rje'i gdung dgod de/ rin chen 'bar bar/ ya phubs tha ma rdo rje gdung*// bdun pa rta babs dag tu 'gyur// brgyad pa pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs// zhes gsungs so// de'i steng nas rta babs rnams brtsegs te/ ka rgyan gyi steng du cha phran gcig pa/ de nas ka ba'i steng du bang rim gnyis pa la cha phran gcig gis thung ba/ de nas mun snam gyi steng du bang rim gsum pa sngar bas cha phran gcig gis thung ba/ de las sgo khang cha phran gcig gis thung ba ni rim pa bzhi pa ste/ de'i steng du pad+ma dang chos 'khor sogs dgod do// de ltar na rta babs ka ba dang bcas pa'i dpangs cha phran dgu yin la/ de bzhin du rtsa ba'i sgo dang*/ sgo khyud dang*/ 'gram logs rnams kyi dpangs kyang cha phran dgu dang*/ sgo'i dpangs kyang sngar bshad pa ltar/ cha chen gnyis yin no// 'o na bri bya la rtsig pa dang rta babs kyi bar la mun snam bshad pa dang 'gal te/

der bar stong mi 'dug pa'i phyir ro snyam na bri bya la mun snam a bha ya'i lugs la yod kyang*/ 'dir shrad+dhās/ sgo'i steng gi cha las cha gcig dor ba zhes bya ba'i de'i phyi rol gyi cha chung gcig dor zhing bzhag la/ zhes pa las mun pa'i tha snyad ma bshad la/ cha gcig po de ni bsgom bya'i skabs su gdung yin par/ rin chen 'bar ba'i lung sngar drangs pas shes so// de ltar na g.yas g.yon gyi rta babs ni ring thung gi tshul du gnas la/ sgo mdun gyi rta babs rnams logs mnyam por yod kyang*/ kha dog mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis snam bu bzhi yod do// gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dur khrod du ni mgon po rol// zhes bshad pa tsam las mi 'byung zhing*/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung rnams dang*/ mngon rtogs don gsal/ dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pa/ byang chub snying po/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rnams kyis kyang*/ dur khrod bshad pa med kyang*/ rje btsun sku mched kyis dur khrod byed par gsungs la/ de bzhin du slob dpon shān+ti pa/ nyin 'byung*/ gnyis med rdo rje/ mar me mdzad/ dza lan dha ri pa/ nag po pa rnams kyi sgrub thabs las dur khrod bshad pas/ 'dir de ltar du bshad pa la gsum/ dur khrod kyi don bshad pa/ de gnas gang du sgom pa/ bsgom bya'i dur khrod dngos so// dang po ni/ dur khrod la ni shwa sa ti zhes 'byung ba'i shwa sa ni ro dang*/ ba sa ti ni gnas te/ ro'i gnas dang*/ yang*/ shā shā na/ zhes pa dur khrod te/ sha ba naṃ ba sa na zhes pa la sha ba'i 'og gi ba mar byas te/ sha la btags na sh+ma dang*/ ba phyi ma ar bsgyur te/ sa la btags pas sā ring por byas pa/ sha swo sh+ma sā nar 'gyur ba mu tig phreng ba las bshad de/ ro gnas par byed pa'o// ro gnas pa'i bya ba byed tshul ni/ ro mgo med kyis 'chag pa dang*/ 'gags te dpyangs pas langs pa dang*/ 'gyel bas ni nyal ba dang*/

gsal shing la bskyon pas ni 'dug pa'i bya ba byed do// des na dur gyi gnas la dur khrod ces bya'o// dur khrod der he ru ka rol par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ man snye las/ ji ltar dur khrod na ro rnams bdag med pa de ltar thams cad la'o// zhes pas bdag med par sems can thams cad gnas pa ni dur khrod de/ sems can rnams sems can gyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang*/ sems can gyi gnas rnams kyang sems can gyi gnas kyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o// zhes dur khrod kyi don te/ des na gnas de kho nar dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab chen po'i bdag nyid byang chub kyi sems chen po phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das rol par rigs so// zhes bshad de snod bcud rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i bdag med la snying rje lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen rol pa mtshon pa'i don du bshad pa legs shing*/ ro'i gdan bshad pa'i nges don yang de ltar yin pas lam 'dir bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid gtan la phebs nas bsgom pa cig nges par dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ dur khrod de dkyil 'khor gyis gang du bsgom snyam na sdom 'byung gi 'gyur kha cig las/ rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du bsgom par bshad pa snang yang*/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang*/ rgya gar ba'i gzhung phal che ba zhig gi dgongs pa ni/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod bsgom pa yin no// 'dir rje btsun sku mched kyis rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol du bsgom pa dang*/ nang du bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis ka gsungs shing*/ de'i nang nas nang du bsgom pa'i bshad pa cung mang ba ni/ dur khrod kyi gzhung che bar/ g.yon gyi shar phyogs phyogs rnams su// g.yas kyi dbang ldan phyogs rnams la// rdo rje gur gyi nang du ni// bzhi bzhir sbyor ba bya ba nyid// gtum mchog gā hā ra nyid dang*// 'bar ba 'khyil pa thod pa can// rnam 'jigs shar la sogs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa la brten par snang zhing*/

de bzhin du man snye las kyang*/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i chos 'byung dang*/ chu skyes dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i khang pa brtsigs pa zhes dang*/ mu tig phreng bar/ rwa ba bzhi'i nang du dur khrod brgyad la sogs pa phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su bsams nas zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no// gsum pa ni/ dur khrod yod pa'i sgrub thabs gzhan rnams dur khrod kyi mngon rtogs cung zad bsdus la/ dza lan+dha ri ba/ nyin 'byung*/ nag po pa gsum gyis rgyas par bshad pa las/ 'dir rje btsun rtse mos/ nag po pa'i gzhung ltar du mdzad pas/ de ltar du bshad na sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba las/ phyi rol dur khrod 'jigs pa ste// rdo rje rwa ba'i nang nyid du// gdug cing drag dang 'thug pa dang*// de bzhin 'bar ba'i phreng ba dang*// 'jigs par byed pa'i thod pa can// g.yon nas shar la sogs pa bzhin// drag tu dgod pa dbang ldan du// dbang phyug nags tshal me yi mtshams// 'jigs byed mun pa bden bral du// rlung du kī li kī la sgrogs// shir+sha a shwad kaṅka li// tsu ti'i shing ni shar sogs rim// shing chen ka rañdza nyid dang*// 'khri shing can dang ardzu na// dbang po nor sbyin zhags pa can// gshin rje'i rgyal po'i phyogs su 'dod// dbang ldan mtshams dang byin za dang*// srin po'i dbang po rlung dag tu'o// nor rgyas bu dang tag sha ka /karko ṭa dang pad+ma dang*// pad+ma chen po hu lun ta// rigs ldan dang ni dung skyong nyid// sgrogs byed 'khor byed 'jigs pa dang*// ldog byed dang ni 'thug po nyid// 'gengs byed dang ni char 'bebs dang*// gtum po rim bzhin sprin gyi bdag /de la brgya byin ni glang por zhon pa mdog ser po lag pa g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa thogs pa'o// nor sbyin ni gnod sbyin la zhon pa mdog ser po gsus pa 'phyang ba mi'u thung g.yon na thod pa dang dbyug pa thogs pa'o// chu lha ni chu srin la zhon pa mdog dkar po sbrul gyis brgyan pa g.yon na thod pa dang zhags pa thogs pa'o// gshin rje ni ma he la zhon pa mdog sngon po lto ba 'phyang ba skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa mi'u thung gi gzugs can g.yon na thod pa dang dbyug pa thogs pa'o// dbang ldan ni glang la zhon pa mig gsum pa mdog dkar po g.yon na thod pa dang mdung thogs pa'o// byin za ni ra skyes la zhon pa mdog dmar ser phyag bzhi pa skra ser po dbyug gu gsum pa dang thod pa dang spyi blugs dang phreng ba 'dzin pa'o// srin po'i bdag po ni ro la zhon pa mi'u thung gi gzugs can mdog sngon po skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba gsus pa 'phyang ba g.yon na ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa'o// rlung gi bdag po ni mdog sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa zhi ba'i gdong pa can ba dan thogs pa'o// 'jig rten skyong ba 'di dag kun rang rang gi mdog dang gdan dang phyag mtshan dang ldan zhing kun kyang g.yas kyi ni bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'o// sprin rnams kyi kha dog ni 'jig rten skyong ba lta bu'o// klu rnams ni de dag la gnas pa ste kun kyang thal mo sbyar ba'o// shing brgyad la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/

'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyi bzhon pa rnams kyi gdong lta bu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa bzhin 'gyur ba ste/ shi ri sha la gnas pa ni lha'i dge 'dun zhes bya ba mdog dkar po'o// shing tsu ta la gnas pa ni gshin rje zhes bya ba ste mdog sngon po'o// a sho ka la gnas pa ni sprin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba ste mdog dmar po'o// byang chub kyi shing la gnas pa ni gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon zhes bya ba ste mdog ser po'o// ka rañdza'i shing la gnas pa ni drang srong 'dus pa zhes bya ba ste mdog dmar po'o// 'khri shing can la gnas pa ni srin po'i tshogs can te kha dog sngon po'o// ardzu na la gnas pa ni rlung gi rgyal po zhes bya ba ste mdog ljang gu'o// shing chen po la gnas pa ni yi dwags 'dus pa zhes bya ba ste du ba'i mdog can blta bar bya'o/ phyogs brgyad kyi dur khrod rnams ni mgo bcad pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ bsnyal ba dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ keng rus dang*/ ba glang gi tshe dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs par byed de/ ma lus pa kun kyang sngon gyi grub pa thob pa rnams kyis mngon par rtogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ gdon dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rnam par brgyan cing sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa blta bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// slob dpon gzhan rnams kyi lugs ni mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bshad la/ dur khrod kyi rang gi ngo bo ni gtum drag la sogs pa brgyad dang*/ der sdom 'byung las/ keng rus dang ni mdung gis phug /'phyang dang phyed tshig pa dang mgo /thod pa byin pa mgo rdum dang*// gtsigs pa'i mgo dang rus pa dang*// zhes mgo bo'i thod rus dang*/ byin pa'i rus pa dang*/

de las gzhan pa'i rus pa 'thor ba dang*/ ma 'thor ba'i keng rus dang*/ mdung gis phug pa'i ro la sogs pa gcal du bkram pa'o// de 'dra ba'i gnas brgyad ni dur khrod dngos yin la/ lhag ma shing dang phyogs skyong sogs ni de na gnas pa yin gyi/ dur khrod dngos ma yin no// zhes bdag gi bla ma mkhas pa dag gsungs so// gnyis pa gzhung don la gsum/ phyi'i dbyibs bshad pa/ nang gi rnam pa bstan pa/ der gdan bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid mtshon pas ngos te logs bzhi pa la rnam par thar pa bzhi dag pas sgo bzhi pa bsam gtan bzhi dag pa'i rta babs bzhis ni sgo bzhi la rnam par brgyan/ rtsa nyon dang nye nyon spangs pas drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pas do shal gyi snam bu la yang dag par ldan pa ste/ des mtshon nas sngar bshad pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ gzhal yas khang pa'i sgo bzhi'i nang gi g.yas g.yon du ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis shin tu mdzes par spras pa la brten pa'i steng thog dang ldan pa de'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba rnams mnyam por gyur pa'i dbus sngon po phyogs mdog las cha phran gcig gis mtho ba/ de'i dbus su gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi sku las skyes pa'i 'od rnams kyis ni rang rang gi gnas 'od gsal bar byas pa la/ lha'i snam bu zhes bya ba yin te/ dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pas/ sa bon las ni spro bar bya// gar byed pa yi lha steng du// pad+ma las ni rim ji bzhin// zhes dang*/ bde ba'i rdo rjes/ lha mo brgyad kyi 'od kyis kyang*// gsal bar lha yi snam byas bya// zhes bshad pas so// des na gzhung 'di'i don/ sgo'i nang du lha snam cha chen gcig bzhag nas de la lha mo brgyad dgod par 'dod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ lha snam byas nas 'phar ma gnyis par 'gyur la/ 'dir rtsa rgyud las/

'phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// des na yab kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir ni chu skyes te/ pad+ma yu ba dang bcas par bsgom ste/ mu tig phreng bar/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gyen du 'phags shing shin tu rgya che ba'i lte ba la zhes gsungs la/ kha dog sna tshogs par nag po pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ rje btsun rtse mo rnams kyis gsungs shing*/ slob dpon 'dis gur gyi sgrub thabs las/ dbus su pad+ma dkar dmar te// zhes gsungs la/ de'i don dbus dkar la mtha' dmar ba'i 'dab ma brgyad du bla ma dag bzhed pa ni/ dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pa dang*/ mngon rtogs don gsal dang*/ gnyis med rdo rjes/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig go /de lta bu'i 'dab ma ni brgyad pa bri zhing*/ phreng ba gcig ces pa ni/ 'phar ma dang*/ kha sbyor dang gsum don gcig tu snang bas 'dab ma'i phyi thig rtsig pa la reg par bskor ba'am/ de gnyis kyi bar du rdo
